source.name: ByteWorks Prototype BIS Dataset
source.note: Synthetic/sample records for testing only. Not authoritative BIS data.

standards.title: Vertical Turbine Pumps for Agricultural Purposes
standards.scope: Prototype pump-related record for semantic retrieval testing.
technical_requirements: Pump performance shall meet specified discharge and head requirements.
Pump construction shall be suitable for the intended water pumping application.
Performance testing shall be carried out according to applicable test procedures.

standards.title: Code of Practice for Water Pumps
standards.scope: Prototype record for general water-pump requirements and application context.
technical_requirements: Pumps shall be suitable for the specified water pumping duty.
Installation and operating conditions shall be considered.
Pump performance characteristics shall be specified and verified.

references.description: Prototype safety requirements for pump installations.

standards.title: Steel Tubes for Water Applications
standards.scope: Prototype allied-material record for water-system retrieval testing.
technical_requirements: Steel components shall meet specified dimensional requirements.
Material properties shall satisfy the intended water-service application.
Testing shall verify applicable material and dimensional characteristics.

standards.title: Safety of Household and Similar Electrical Appliances — General Requirements
standards.scope: Prototype electrical-safety record for retrieval testing.
technical_requirements: Electrical equipment shall provide protection against electric shock.
Insulation and electrical construction shall satisfy applicable safety requirements.
Protection against abnormal operation shall be considered.

standards.title: Hydraulic Performance Testing of Pumps
standards.scope: Prototype test-method record for pump performance retrieval.
technical_requirements: Pump discharge shall be measured under defined test conditions.
Head and efficiency shall be determined from test measurements.
Performance results shall be recorded for comparison with specified requirements.

standards.title: Three Phase Induction Motors
standards.scope: Prototype motor-related record for retrieval from pump specifications.
technical_requirements: Motor rated power shall be specified.
Motor speed and operating characteristics shall be compatible with the application.
Electrical and mechanical performance shall satisfy the specified operating conditions.

standards.title: Centrifugal Pumps for Industrial Water Supply
standards.scope: Synthetic high-relevance record specifically created to test ByteWorks Query retrieval for industrial centrifugal water pumps.
technical_requirements: The standard applies to centrifugal pumps intended for industrial water supply.
Pump performance shall be specified using parameters such as head, discharge and efficiency.
Rated motor power and rotational speed shall be compatible with the specified pump duty.
Materials used in pump construction shall be suitable for the intended water-service environment.
Performance testing shall verify the specified operating characteristics.

standards.title: Industrial Pump Safety and Installation Requirements
standards.scope: Prototype record for pump safety and installation retrieval.
technical_requirements: Pump installation shall provide appropriate mechanical stability.
Electrical connections shall be protected against relevant hazards.
Operating and maintenance instructions shall be provided.
